==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged, but ''only'' when the target is attacking.
* If used against a target that is in the middle of casting a spell while they are under the effect of [[Daze]], or if [[Dwarven Battle Stance]] is in effect, the interrupt will land before Counter Blow activates. Making it possible to cause the knockdown effect if the enemy is set to an "attacking" state.

== Notes ==
* This is the only non-[[elite]], non-[[PvE-only]], [[adrenaline|adrenal]] skill that causes a knock down without causing the user to lose all adrenaline.
